title: A Living Flush
caption:
Some colour rests on the skin.
Liquid blush rises from within it.

It melts in, and the cheeks look full,
as though warmth were surfacing from inside.
Feminine, and quietly sensual.

In a deeper shade, it turns sharp, almost cool.
But what draws me is how alive it leaves the skin.
Fresh. A little raw. Full of energy.

When I want to look healthy rather than polished,
this is the colour I choose.

Not a finished face.
A living one.
